Sonia Gandhi Memoir 'Belonging' to be Published by HarperCollins India

Sonia Gandhi's memoir, titled 'Belonging: A Journey of Love,' is set to be published by HarperCollins India on November 10. This follows a decision by Penguin Random House India not to proceed with the publication. Reports indicate Penguin's withdrawal came after Sonia Gandhi declined certain suggested editorial changes and deletions. HarperCollins India will now handle the memoir's release.
